scope: Six already saved BTCUSDT 1m monthly archives, Spot and USD-M June-August2026; no data replay or source acquisition

facts_ru: Связывает Spot CSV с /api/v3/klines, USD-M CSV с /fapi/v1/klines и задаёт порядок12 полей
Для Spot с2025-01-01 timestamps в микросекундах
Архивы могут впоследствии обновляться: сохранённый hash важнее сегодняшнего same-URL файла

primary_sources.locator: baseAsset, quoteAsset, quantity, isBuyerMaker, opening disclaimer
facts_ru: Оговорка glossary: определения относятся только кSpot и могут отличаться вFutures

common_archive_columns.meaning: Начало свечи; не время публикации/получения архива

common_archive_columns.status: INCOMPLETE: selected CSV/REST table calls it volume without explicit base/contract unit; do not infer from magnitude, suffix, taker subset, or Spot Testnet

common_archive_columns.meaning: Конец свечи; исходную квантованную запись сохранить

spot.asset_binding_basis: Explicit BTCUSDT example in official Spot glossary, not suffix inference
spot.timestamp_basis: Official public-data Spot2025+ rule plus bounded original first-two-row crosscheck; does not imply RESTdefault is microseconds
spot.open_epoch_ms_rule: Keep original integer lexeme; require exact open %1000=0, divide by1000
spot.end_exclusive_ms_rule: Keep original inclusive close; require exact (close+1)%1000=0, then (close+1)/1000. Do not floor inclusive microsecond close and silently discard remainder.

usd_m_futures.asset_binding_status: Saved declaration retained separately; official USD-M concrete instrument schema unavailable in this bounded documentation read. Spot glossary disclaimer prevents inheriting its binding as Futures proof.
usd_m_futures.open_epoch_ms_rule_for_saved_rows: Exact original integer already maps to2026 UTC monthstart; next open +60000
usd_m_futures.end_exclusive_ms_rule_for_saved_rows: Original inclusive close+1; one minute quantum60000

taker_boundary.officially_named_subset: Columns9/10 describe quantity for taker buyers, in base and quote assets respectively
taker_boundary.total_minus_taker_buy: Potential arithmetic complement only; not performed or requalified as independent native sell evidence in this documentary package

limitations: Schema mapping is not full264960-row validation
ThreeSpot and threeUSD-M files are two markets of one Binance upstream, not independent providers
Same-index ratios require same instrument/market/unit/timeframe; not crossmarket sums or venue agreement
No FX, divide-by2, contract-size conversion, 4h-to15m reconstruction, score or ENTRY
Native publication_ts/source_ts remain null; October acquisition availability is not June exante firstknowledge
Current docs read inOctober do not prove unchanged historical schema publication; saved structure match only
